env.name: VBCDX_FORGEJO_URL
env.description: Forgejo instance origin, optionally with a deployment subpath and a trailing api/v1 path

env.name: VBCDX_FORGEJO_WRITES
env.description: Write gate: off (default, reads only), write, or full (also destructive tools)

env.name: VBCDX_FORGEJO_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Total per-call deadline in milliseconds, 1000 to 120000 (default 30000)

env.name: VBCDX_FORGEJO_HTTP_HOST
env.description: Network mode only: bind address (default loopback only; the Docker image listens on all interfaces)

env.name: VBCDX_FORGEJO_TLS_CERT
env.description: Network mode only: PEM certificate path, set together with the key to serve HTTPS

env.name: VBCDX_FORGEJO_TLS_KEY
env.description: Network mode only: PEM private key path, set together with the certificate

env.name: VBCDX_FORGEJO_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
env.description: Network mode only: comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the server (default none)
